_comment: Per-string context pushed to Crowdin by `npm run i18n:context`. One line per key saying where the string appears and what constrains it — the facts a translator cannot get from the English alone. Written when the string is, by whoever ran /wording. Keys mirror en.json.
given_action: Tooltip on an action pip granted by another card. {{originator}} is that card's name.
standard_action: Tooltip on an ordinary, unspent action pip.
end_turn: Button below the action pips. Two words at most.
buttons.draw_card: Button in the actions area. `#n#` renders as the Arkham symbol glyph and must survive verbatim.
buttons.take_resource: Button in the actions area. `#n#` renders as the Arkham symbol glyph and must survive verbatim.
buttons.view_discard: Button in the actions area. `#f#` renders as the Arkham symbol glyph and must survive verbatim.
spent_on.investigate: Tooltip on a spent action pip, naming what it was spent on. {{target}} is a location.
spent_on.move: Tooltip on a spent action pip. {{target}} is a location.
spent_on.draw: Tooltip on a spent action pip. No target.
spent_on.resource: Tooltip on a spent action pip. No target.
spent_on.play: Tooltip on a spent action pip. {{target}} is a card name.
spent_on.activate: Tooltip on a spent action pip. {{target}} is a card name.
spent_on.fight: Tooltip on a spent action pip. {{target}} is an enemy.
spent_on.engage: Tooltip on a spent action pip. {{target}} is an enemy.
spent_on.evade: Tooltip on a spent action pip. {{target}} is an enemy. Evade is a Fantasy Flight action name.
restrictions.evade_only: Restriction shown on the actions area. `@Evade@` renders bold italic and must survive verbatim.
